purpose: complete planned class and major skill allocation

entities.name: Gravemancer
entities.concept: Controls bounded vector fields, lift zones, crush lanes, and momentum transfer rather than relying on raw projectile damage.

entities.name: Chronarch
entities.concept: Uses recorded authored states, delayed echoes, timing windows, and replay tracks to control encounters without literal unrestricted time travel.

entities.visual_identity: Silver regalia with transparent clock plates and rotating offset rings.
entities.animation_profile: Casting deliberately desynchronizes limb afterimages before snapping them back into alignment.
entities.vfx_profile: Clock rings, ghost-state silhouettes, timeline rails, and restrained local time-snap effects.
